did: Built home's half of IW8 in four server PRs, all merged. Home now keeps the new interview week format with its ready answers. A send may say how each answer was given (aloud, from cues, or in the owner's own words), and the week's record passes that through with each question's ground. Each question's first take goes home on its own, and the record names it. When a week closes, each question keeps the audio of its first take, its newest, and the one the owner sent; every other take's audio is let go with a receipt, and every transcript stays. Reviews caught two real bugs before merge: the essay pass could close a week without the let-go, and a let-go take's audio answered an error instead of 'not found'.

calls.title: Only a take home has judged heard loses its audio at week close
options: let go any middle take that a model has finished hearing and that waits on nothing from the owner (C558's words)
let go only a middle take whose newest verdict is heard; one not yet judged keeps its audio
calls.why: A take heard but not yet judged could still be heard again, and the owner's own delete already refuses a take not yet judged. Keeping more than the rule asks never loses the record; the coordinator agreed.
calls.undo: In server crates/db/voice/src/interview.rs, let_go_retakes: let a take go when its verdict doesn't ask the owner to act, rather than only when it is heard.

calls.title: A question's ground is an open word, not a fixed list
options: accept only open and work, refusing the week otherwise
pass any slug through, and read anything else as no ground
calls.why: A third ground, decision, is coming (some-ui#3181), and the week is the routine's to validate. Home only passes it through, so an unknown value should never make a week unreadable.
calls.undo: In server crates/db/rust_round/src/interview.rs, turn ground back into a closed enum and refuse other values.

left: server#969: the week's note lookup reads every subject's notes for that week, because the index has no subject column. Harmless with one owner; it proposes an index and a query-plan test.
server#953: the chrono advisory keeps Rust Deny Checks (advisories) red on every PR. It's not required, and PR gate passes.
